author: Nerdstalgic
description:
Star Wars films used to feel like the biggest event in the world.  People waited years for new movies. Fans camped outside theaters. Every release felt massive, important, and unforgettable. 

But in today's content landscape, it seems Star Wars has morphed into just that....content.  What once felt like ground breaking cinematic storytelling, has now become a passive TV event that nobody is watching.

But how did one of the most beloved franchises in entertainment become something audiences casually scroll past on Disney+?  Has Star Wars really lost its cultural dominance?

#starwars #lucasfilm #disney #nerdstalgic
title: The Biggest Problem Lucasfilm Created
